name: U17-1-confirmed-save-home
steps:
# Windows notes
Keep the line endings.
const s=document.querySelector('.library-screen');if(!s?.textContent.includes('No retained saves')||s.textContent.includes('Needs checking'))throw Error('Confirmed save left a recovery anomaly');

name: U17-2-removed-blank-line
steps:
# Windows notes
Keep the line endings.

const line=document.querySelector('.diff__line--remove');const code=line?.querySelector('.diff__text');if(code?.textContent!=='Removed: blank line'||[...code.children].some(c=>!c.matches('.visually-hidden')))throw Error('Blank cell is not empty and named');if(getComputedStyle(line).textDecorationLine.includes('line-through')||getComputedStyle(code).textDecorationLine.includes('line-through'))throw Error('Blank line is struck through');const other=document.querySelector('.diff__line--same');if(Math.abs(line.getBoundingClientRect().height-other.getBoundingClientRect().height)>1)throw Error('Blank row lost its normal height');

name: U17-3-recent-human-decision
steps: (async()=>{const {ids}=await import('/src/dev/sim/scenario.ts');const {delayedDecision}=await import('/src/dev/sim/talkWork.ts');const {UiStore}=await import('/src/app/ui.ts');const h=window.__sim.host;const id=delayedDecision(h);const t=h.tasks.find(t=>t.task_id===id);const r=h.runs.find(r=>r.run_id===t.current_run);localStorage.setItem('sim.human-decisions',JSON.stringify({[r.run_id]:{resolution:'mark_completed',at:Date.now(),by:{kind:'device',device_id:ids.device}}}));const ui=new UiStore('sim-studio');ui.selectTask(t.project_id,id);ui.selectTab('talk');ui.persistNow();setTimeout(()=>location.reload(),100)})()

const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.talk-new button.row')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Recover the interrupted migration'));if(row?.querySelector('.pill')?.textContent!=='Marked completed')throw Error('Recent task has the wrong label');row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});

name: U17-5-next-up-paused-1280
steps: const pill=[...document.querySelectorAll('.work-screen .pill')].find(p=>['Paused','Running'].includes(p.textContent));if(!pill)throw Error('Queue state missing');pill.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});const r=pill.getBoundingClientRect(),parent=pill.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>=parent.width/2)throw Error('Queue state still stretches: '+r.width);
